turns.q: My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
turns.replyTail:
I am sorry to hear that an item in your order arrived damaged.

To help you as best I can and access your file, could you please provide me with your order number, the email address used for your purchase, and your phone number?

Once I have this information, I will be able to identify your order and assist you in resolving this issue. 🙂

turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
A damaged item is indeed handled differently than a standard return. For a damaged or defective item, we need to visualize the issue to provide the best resolution.

Could you please share your order number, email address, and phone number?

Once I have located your order, I will guide you through the next steps, which will include providing a description of the damage along with some photos or a short video. 🙂

turns.q: Will I get a replacement or a refund?
turns.replyTail:
For a damaged item, we will first assess the situation with the photos you provide. Depending on the case, we can arrange for an exchange of the defective part or a full replacement of the product.

Please note that we don't do standard exchanges where you would choose a different item; if a replacement is needed, it will be for the same product you originally ordered.

To get started, could you please share your order number, email address, and phone number? 🙂

turns.q: Do I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?
turns.replyTail:
Rest assured, if your product is confirmed as damaged or defective, we will cover the shipping costs for the replacement. If a return of the defective item is necessary, we will also reimburse the reasonable return shipping costs based on supporting documents.

To assist you further and find the best solution, could you please provide your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and your phone number? 🙂
